          const fs=require('fs');
          const request=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.REQUEST,'utf8'));
          const safeState={repositoryWrites:false,dataWrites:false,deploy:false,merge:false,production:false,imports:false,payments:false,make:false,gemini:false,firestoreWrites:false,authWrites:false,storageWrites:false,hrWrites:false};
          const gateRequest={
            schemaVersion:'cxorbia.readonly-post-gates-request.v1',
            requestId:request.requestId+'-predeploy-current-composition',
            enabled:true,
            repository:request.repository,
            branch:request.branch,
            pullRequest:request.pullRequest,
            targetHeadSha:request.sourceLockHead,
            profile:'PHASE_A_COMPLETE_COMPOSITION_SOURCE_STATIC',
            allowedProfiles:['PHASE_A_COMPLETE_COMPOSITION_SOURCE_STATIC'],
            allowedExecutions:1,
            repositoryWrites:false,
            dataWrites:false,
            providerReads:false,
            deploy:false,
            merge:false,
            production:false,
            sourceLockDocument:'app/docs/MANIFEST-PHASE-A-COMPLETA-FINAL-COMPOSICION-20260804.json',
            safeState,
            containsPii:false,
            containsSecrets:false,
            purpose:'Fail-closed predeploy revalidation of the active V7.2-P0F1 composition and DEV scenario Lab source contract.'
          };
          fs.writeFileSync(process.env.OUT+'/source-static-request.json',JSON.stringify(gateRequest,null,2)+'\n','utf8');
          NODE
          node tools/release/cxorbia-phase-a-complete-composition-source-static-runner.mjs "$OUT/source-static-request.json" | tee "$OUT/source-static-runner.log"

          const fs=require('fs');
          const report=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.tmp/cxorbia-readonly-post-gates-runner/report.json','utf8'));
          const summary=report.summary||{};
          if(report.status!=='PASS_READONLY_POST_GATES')throw new Error('phase_a_source_static_runner_not_pass');
          if(!String(summary.decision||'').startsWith('PASS_PHASE_A_COMPLETE_COMPOSITION_SOURCE_STATIC_GATE'))throw new Error('phase_a_composition_not_pass');
          if(summary.labSourceContract?.decision!=='PASS_TYA_DEV_SCENARIO_LAB_SOURCE_CONTRACT')throw new Error('lab_source_contract_not_pass');
          console.log('PASS PHASE_A_COMPLETE_COMPOSITION_SOURCE_STATIC');
          console.log('PASS TYA_DEV_SCENARIO_LAB_SOURCE_CONTRACT');
          console.log('DECISION PASS_C6_UNIFIED_CUMULATIVE_RUNTIME_STATIC_GATE');
          NODE
          grep -q 'DECISION PASS_C6_UNIFIED_CUMULATIVE_RUNTIME_STATIC_GATE' "$OUT/static-cumulative.log"
          node tools/qa/tya-c6-shopper-new-tab-authority-root-fix-gate.mjs | tee "$OUT/static-root-fix.log"
